init.title: ChromaComfort options
init.description: How often should Home Assistant re-read the fan's state? Each check briefly takes the fan's Bluetooth connection, during which the ChromaComfort phone app cannot control it. Home Assistant reads the state whenever it sends a command regardless, so a long interval is usually fine.
